novofab-nf-a-cnc.summary: Production saws with CNC feeding and cutting: a servo-driven feeder positions the stock, hydraulic vises clamp it, the servo blade drive sets a stepless cutting speed and the PLC runs the batch. The NF-A 350 and NF-A 415 have an automatic rotary bow (45°) and chip extraction; the NF-A 460 feeds up to 650 mm per stroke with a linear scale on the feed and a swivelling control panel; the NF-A 600 cuts 850 × 600 mm sections with a hydraulic feeder as standard.
features: Round capacity from Ø350 mm to Ø600 mm; mitre cuts to 45° (NF-A 460: 60°)
CNC / PLC automatic feeding and clamping, hydraulic vises
Servo motor for stepless blade speed; industrial gearbox (NF-A 460)
Feed per stroke: 500 mm (NF-A 350/415), 650 mm (NF-A 460), 600 mm (NF-A 600)
Work light, chip extraction and coolant system included

novofab-nf-dc280.name: NF-DC 280 series double column band saws
novofab-nf-dc280.models_label: NF-DC 280 · NF-DC 280 T · NF-DC 280 A · NF-DC 280 AV
novofab-nf-dc280.summary: Twin-column saws for Ø280 mm / 280 × 280 mm stock: the bow travels vertically on two columns, so the cut stays square whatever the feed pressure. Hydraulic down-feed with variable speed, hydraulic clamping and automatic shut-off on every model. Choose the base machine with hand-wheel feed (NF-DC 280), the mitre version that cuts at 30° and 45° (NF-DC 280 T), the automatic with a 3-position shuttle vise (NF-DC 280 A) or the automatic with stepless blade speed, chip conveyor and the new vise design (NF-DC 280 AV).
features: Ø280 mm round / 280 × 280 mm square; NF-DC 280 T: Ø260 mm at 30°, Ø170 mm at 45°
Double column — vertical, rigid bow travel
Hydraulic variable down-feed, hydraulic clamping, auto shut-off
NF-DC 280 A / AV: automatic feed and cut, 3-position vise for bundle cutting, feed length by limit switch
NF-DC 280 AV: variable blade speed 0–61 m/min, automatic chip conveyor
Belt drive, 3 kW motor; work light, coolant and material stand included

novofab-nf-dc350.name: NF-DC 350 and NF-DC 400 gear-driven double column saws
novofab-nf-dc350.summary: Heavier twin-column saws with a gear-driven two-speed motor, hydraulic blade tensioning and hydraulic clamping. Vertical lifting on two columns keeps the blade square in Ø350 mm and Ø400 mm solids; the cutting feed is hydraulically controlled and stepless. A three-position hydraulic clamping vise for bundles is optional.
features: Double column structure, vertical lifting, high stability
Hydraulic variable down-feed, hydraulic clamping, hydraulic blade tensioning
Gear drive with two-speed motor (2.2/2.8 kW or 3.0/4.0 kW)
Work light, coolant pump and material stand included

novofab-nf-dc500.name: NF-DC 500 and NF-DC 600 gantry double column saws
novofab-nf-dc500.summary: Gantry-type double column saws for heavy plate, blocks, bundles and large tube: Ø500 mm / 700 × 500 mm on the NF-DC 500 and Ø600 mm / 1200 × 600 mm on the NF-DC 600. Hydraulic clamping, stepless blade speed and a powered roller table; the NF-DC 600 adds hydraulic blade tensioning and an 11 kW motor for the 67 mm blade.
features: Double column gantry structure for batch sawing of tubes, bars, profiles and plates
Hydraulic clamping; variable blade speed (40–80 and 20–80 m/min)
NF-DC 500: 5.5 kW, 41 × 1.3 mm blade · NF-DC 600: 11 kW, 67 × 1.3 × 8800 mm blade, hydraulic tensioning
Powered roller table with chain drive
